text:
Marisol: Quick sync — preflight for Zephyr private cutover. Two asks: (1) circuit-breaker egress fallback proof-of-life (need test steps + evidence), (2) who owns cert burn/rotation for airgapped registry. Can owners reply with short status? TL;DR by EOD please.

Ethan: I can take circuit-breaker tests. Quick Q — do we validate at VPC egress or node-level? We shipped a router-level CB earlier.

Priya: For Zephyr we agreed node-level CB (so each inference node can failover). I can run smoke tests tomorrow but need the IP ranges to simulate egress block.

Sam: I can own registry cert rotation for the airgap bundle. Registry team keeps the certs but I'll coordinate the manual import. ETA tomorrow noon.

InfraBot: job created: job/zephyr-cb-smoke (CI) — logs: https://internal-ci.company/zephyr/123 (will populate after runs)

Marisol: Added the IP ranges to the preflight doc: https://docs.company/zephyr-preflight (see section "egress-sim"). Please add short notes with pass/fail and attach the CI run id. Also confirm fallback to on-prem model variant when CB trips.

Ethan: Starting from staging bridge host I'll run:
```
# simulate blocked egress to model backend
curl -sv --resolve api.redwood.test:443:198.51.100.1 https://api.redwood.test/health
```
Posting logs to CI job when done.

Priya: Note: if CB trips we can see KV cache invalidation and a hit to cold-starts — I'll record latency deltas. Fallback sequence uses flag `--fallback-variant=micro` in the router config. I'll verify behavior and the rollback guard.

Sam: Registry cert rotation plan: rotate cert, re-sign artifacts, rebuild airgap bundle, circulate to customer. Security asked we keep previous cert for 72h overlap. Pinged @AmirSec for approval.

AmirSec: Security OK for rotation with 72h grace, just include an auditable rotation entry in the runbook and snapshot the old certs in vault.

Ethan: Ran CB smoke. Initial result: when egress blocked we got 502s — looks like CB engaged but fallback didn't trigger. CI run id 345. Posting logs to job/zephyr-cb-smoke.

Priya: Saw the same in canary traces — missing `x-fallback-variant` header in router->proxy mapping. I'll push a tiny routing patch to inject header for fallback path.

Ethan: Patch applied to canary, re-ran smoke. Now responses from fallback variant are returning 200. CI run id 678. Adding results to sheet. :thumbsup:

Sam: Security approved rotation (per AmirSec). Scheduling rotation at 02:00 UTC tomorrow; I'll publish the step-by-step playbook and include rollback steps.

Marisol: Owners confirmed: Ethan -> circuit-breaker tests & CI evidence, Priya -> fallback verification + cold-start metrics, Sam -> registry cert rotation + playbook. Please update the preflight checklist row (sheet link) with run ids and any open blockers. If anything blocks, tag me ASAP.

Ethan: Added run ids (345, 678) and logs. One open note: we saw 3s spike on tail latency during fallback; Priya will add metric snapshots.

Priya: Added latency snapshots and the canary trace. Cold-start delta ~2.9s for first few requests, then normalizes. Filing a follow-up ticket for optimizations.

Sam: Playbook posted: https://internal-runbooks/company/zephyr/registry-rotate (includes manual import steps and verification). I'll leave the old cert in vault for 72h post-rotation.

Marisol: Great work — if everything is green we'll mark Zephyr "Ready for cutover" by 14:00 UTC tomorrow. Thanks all :rocket:

Ethan: Sounds good — I'll be on call for the cutover window.

Priya: I'll be available for rollback/metrics during cutover.

Sam: I'll monitor registry import and be on standby.

Marisol: Closing the loop — anyone with questions DM me.
